ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Verification_Status__c), "Failed"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Amazon Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Requested"), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Ready For Review"), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Passed"), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Unable to Provide") ), NOT(ISBLANK(Status_Reason__c)) )
